messages.text:
Happy to help you land on the right one.

Two quick things: what's your budget, and where will it run (country, and is noise a problem)?

If you want the short version, our two picks are the Magic Miner 40T at $799 for 40 TH/s, the best value per terahash we sell, and the Harlo B30 at $899 for 30 TH/s, quiet and tidy. Both are pre-sale. Smaller in-stock units start around $239 if you just want something running now.
